title: Teardrop twins: two crews, 3,000 km apart, filmed the same "tail" UAP
parts:
Two military crews. 3,000+ km apart. Five months apart.
Both filmed a round object with a rigid "tail" hanging straight down 👀
DOW-UAP-PR028 vs DOW-UAP-PR029 🧵

1/ Greece, Jan 2024. The crew's own report:
"ROUND DIAMOND SHAPE WITH STRAIGHT, NON MANUEVERABLE TAIL"
~434 knots. Seen ONLY on the short-wave IR camera; switch to normal video and it vanishes.

2/ Gulf of Oman, Jun 2024. Different crew, different aircraft:
"GLOWING HOT SPHERICAL OBJECT WITH A VERTICAL UNWAVERING CYLINDRICAL POLE/BAR ATTACHED ON THE BOTTOM"
~140 knots. Crew's verdict: "Benign".

3/ The tell: the tail never swings. Step through frame by frame: whatever the camera does, it points straight DOWN.
That's gravity. A light round body with something hanging under it is the classic balloon + payload silhouette.

4/ And 434 knots? That's a dot timed from a fast jet with no range to it. AARO's GoFast card: the "high-speed" object was really doing 5-92 mph; the speed was "motion parallax". Far, slow things look fast from a moving jet.

5/ Bonus: the dark ring around both isn't a force field 😅 It's the sensor's sharpening filter overshooting at a bright edge. Similar cameras → same halo.
AARO still lists both as unresolved. Object or balloon?

6/ Check it yourself, free:
• realufo.org/archive → search "teardrop" → Video
• open each file, tap the moment, press , and . to step frames
• read both crews' mission reports in the file text

evidence.label: Greece, Jan 2024: the "tail" hangs straight down
evidence.evidence: SWIR video. AARO's description: "an inverted teardrop with a vertically linear trailing mass suspended below". At 0:56 the operator switches to visible light and loses it.

evidence.label: Gulf of Oman, Jun 2024: same shape, same straight-down tail
evidence.evidence: IR video over the sea. AARO uses the exact same words: "an inverted teardrop with a vertically linear trailing mass suspended below".

evidence.label: Mission report for the Greece video
evidence.evidence: "ROUND DIAMOND SHAPE WITH STRAIGHT, NON MANUEVERABLE 'TAIL'" … "APPROX 434 KNOTS" … "THE UAP ONLY APPEARED ON THE SWIR CAMERA" (p.7). The event lasted about 2 minutes.

evidence.label: Mission report for the Gulf of Oman video
evidence.evidence: "GLOWING HOT SPHERICAL UNIDENTIFIED OBJECT WITH A VERTICAL UNWAVERING CYLINDRICAL POLE/BAR ATTACHED ON THE BOTTOM" … "MOVING AT 140KNOTS" (p.7). The observing aircraft was at 23,999 ft, 163 kts; observer assessment: Benign (p.6).

evidence.label: Why a far, slow object can look fast
evidence.evidence: AARO's GoFast resolution: reported "near ocean's surface" at "high speeds"; assessed at about 13,000 ft doing 5-92 mph (p.1). "The object's apparent high speed is attributable to motion parallax." (p.3) The same effect applies to any speed called out from a moving jet without a range.
